Hi Sarah —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood. I saw your account flagged a high sustained load pattern and wanted to set up a short call to qualify whether Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) makes sense for you. Typical items we cover: throughput targets, 99th/median latency expectations, and integration constraints (VPC, keys).

If you can share a quick note on: average QPS, peak QPS, typical request token size, and acceptable p99 latency, that will help us scope the right reservation.

I’m cc’ing Marissa (Solutions Eng) to join the call — she’ll handle technical sizing.

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick reach out. Happy to take a qualification call. Some details up front:
- Average: ~120 QPS steady during batch windows;
- Peak: brief spikes to ~600 QPS when we run parallel inference batches;
- Typical payload: 1100–1800 tokens per request (mostly long-context summarization);
- Target p99: <= 200ms for tail-sensitive UX.

I attached a sample traffic export. Ops (ops@novusai.com) is copied for scheduling/NDAs. Could we aim for the earlier slot on Tue 12/2? If an exec joins we may need a 45-min slot.
